Nothing says calm like a sudden QB3.

results.concept: The Nuggets say everything is on the table this summer, but nobody knows if that actually includes changing the non-Jokic minutes that keep wrecking games.

drafts.option1:
Nuggets say everything is on the table this summer. Cool. Let me know when that includes the part where Jokic sits and the score turns into a crime scene.

Fix the non Jokic minutes or stop selling us “options.”
drafts.option2:
Everything is on the table, except the only math that matters. When Jokic rests we do cardio, take bad shots, then call it “learning.”

That is not a roster plan, that is a countdown timer.
drafts.option3:
Fans are already talking themselves into “internal growth” like we did not watch the same movie all year. Jokic sits, the offense forgets how to get a shot, and we start praying for timeouts.

That is the bench identity.

You cannot manage a playoff crease like a fantasy lineup.

Avs fans are gonna talk themselves into the goalie switch like its 4D chess. It is just panic after one bad night.

We are doing the most at the most important position.
